x: Edmund Donovan had to cut short his visit to the U.K. last year. His wife, Daye, wrote to us on his behalf after he had had an operation on his hip; however, come Christmas we find him sending greetings in his own handwriting with a hope to visit us again this year.

At the end of January your President, Gordon Doubleday and Clive Shippen were invited to lunch by DAYE DONOVAN at her London hotel. Although it was a pleasure to meet Daye again the occasion was rather sad because she would normally have been accompanied on her journey from New York by EDMUND, one o…

But these were out-done by three who flew the Atlantic especially for the occasion; Daye Donovan from New York (how Edmund would have loved to have been present), Chris Steer from Seattle and John Thresher from Toronto.
DAYE DONOVAN writes from New York and reciprocates our wishes for a Happy New Year. She recently enjoyed an intoxicating trip around India, but did not see Rangit Bhatia in her travels.
